blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Justice Secretary Fredderick Vida on Wednesday called on Batangas 1st District Rep. Leandro Leviste to return to the Philippines and submit to court jurisdiction, warning that failing to follow judicial orders directly disrespects the country’s legal process. “If we disobey the court’s orders, we are disrespecting the system,” Vida said. The Makati City Regional Trial Court issued an arrest order against Leviste for violating the Public Service Act.
